idea-plugin.name: Muse Spark Code (Unofficial)
idea-plugin.description:
Muse Spark Code (Unofficial) puts Meta's Muse Spark model to work as a coding agent inside IntelliJ-based IDEs. It is an independent, open-source (MIT) project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta.

  • A chat panel in a tool window. Answers stream in, every file change is shown as a diff, and commands and edits wait for your approval.
  • Edits in your own editors. Changes are applied to open files in one undo step, and only in projects you have trusted.
  • Optional inline completions. Tab accepts and Escape rejects. They are paid per use and capped per day, and nothing is charged before you agree.
  • Your credentials stay out of the plugin. Sign-in and keys are kept in the operating system's credential store by the runtime; the plugin never asks for a key.
  • 15 interface languages.

Requirements. An IntelliJ-based IDE from 2025.3 to 2026.2, Node.js 22 or later, and the muse-spark-code-acp runtime on your PATH (npm install -g muse-spark-code-acp). You bring your own access: a Muse subscription through the Muse Code CLI, or a Meta Model API key that is billed per call.

Source code, documentation and the privacy policy: github.com/RandyNorthrup/muse-spark-code.

Unofficial. "Muse Spark" and "Muse Code" are trademarks of Meta. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• First release for IntelliJ-based IDEs 2025.3 to 2026.2.
  • The Muse Spark Code panel as a tool window, an editor tab or a separate window.
  • File edits through the IDE's own editors, in one undo step, in trusted projects.
  • Optional paid inline completions: Tab accepts, Escape rejects.
  • When the embedded browser (JCEF) is not available, the panel opens in your web browser instead.
